steps.see: Sign in to join the conversation

name: comments--host
note: The host sees the same page; the difference (Pin) is in the comment menu: see comments--comment-menu-host.

name: comments--empty
note: {episode2} must be an episode with no comments.

name: comments--comment-menu
note: First comment on the page must be written by someone else.

name: comments--comment-menu-host
note: Host variant: Pin / Pin to bottom rows appear for the proven host of the show.

name: comments--comment-menu-signed-out
note: A visitor sees only Share / Copy / Save / Report (no Mute, no Mark as unfriendly).

name: comments--moment-like-toast

steps.see: Couldn't save that like — try again.

note: Raised by the player moment sheet when liking a comment fails. Needs a seeded comment at the playing position; the fault path and the like control label follow MomentSheet.tsx and may need the capture lane to adjust.

name: comments--composer-sheet
note: The write box name is "Write a comment at m:ss" (time follows the playhead), so the visible placeholder text is tapped.

name: comments--community-rules
note: A new account has not accepted the community rules; the server refuses the first comment and the composer shows the rules.

name: comments--picture-full-size

steps.tap: The picture in this comment. Opens it full size

note: Needs a seeded comment that carries a picture (comment images switched on); the first one on the page is tapped.

name: comments--voice-record
note: The microphone is allowed by the earlier permission entry; on a first run the system prompt shows first (see comments--microphone-permission).

name: comments--microphone-permission
note: The first request is the iOS microphone alert (then the speech-recognition alert). Simulator-only system alerts.

name: comments--community-rules-voice

steps.tap: Stop recording and check the text

note: A voice comment from an account that has not accepted the rules opens RulesSheet. Depends on the simulator recording at least one second and the speech path (otherwise the stop button is "Stop and post the voice comment"). Low confidence.

name: comments--reply-composer
note: The reply variant of the composer ("Reply" title, "Write a reply" box).

name: comments--share-sheet
note: The native iOS share sheet is the shot.

name: comments--toast
note: Triggered message: "Copied."

name: comments--composer-toast
covers: src/ui/comments/Composer.tsx::toast::Sent. The host reviews comments here first. Until then, only you can see it.
src/ui/comments/Composer.tsx::toast::Your comment is posted, but the picture did not upload.

steps.see: Sent. The host reviews comments here first. Until then, only you can see it.

note: Triggered message: "Sent. The host reviews comments here first…". {episode3} must belong to a show with comment review switched on; the other message needs a picture upload to fail.

name: comments--voice-toast
covers: src/ui/comments/VoiceRecord.tsx::toast::SocialNet needs the microphone — allow it in the phone's settings.
src/ui/comments/VoiceRecord.tsx::toast::That was too short — record at least a second.

steps.tap: Stop recording and check the text

steps.see: That was too short — record at least a second.

note: Triggered message: "That was too short — record at least a second." Stopping at once. Speech path only; low confidence.

name: comment-thread--empty

steps.see: No replies yet — be the first.

note: {comment} is a top-level comment with no replies; {thread} is one with replies.

name: comment-thread--load-failed

steps.see: Couldn't load the replies — pull back and try again.

note: Replies come from the episode social payload; with no cached copy the page says it could not load.

name: comment-thread--share-sheet
note: The native iOS share sheet is the shot.

name: comment-thread--toast
note: Triggered message: "Copied."

name: chat-thread--screen
note: Header name comes from the thread; the pair should follow each other so the box is enabled.

name: chat-thread--cannot-send

steps.see: You can send messages while you both follow each other.

note: A new account does not follow {user} back.

name: chat-thread--error
note: Thread load fails with nothing cached; the page shows the line.

name: chat-thread--toast

steps.see: Couldn't send — check your connection and try again.

note: Triggered message: "Couldn't send — check your connection and try again." An ApiError that is not a network error shows its own message instead; low confidence on which the fault gives.

steps.see: Sign in to chat with people who follow you back

name: chat-new--send-to
note: The share-an-episode variant ("Send to" with the episode title as subtitle).

name: notifications--people
note: People tab (the page opens on it). Pills are tapped by their visible titles "People" / "Interactions"; their accessible name carries a count line.

steps.see: Sign in to follow people and see what they listen to.
No activity yet — follow people from their profile

name: notifications--feed-offline

steps.see: You're offline and nothing is saved here yet.

note: A failed first load with no cached copy shows the offline variant of the feed surface.

name: notifications--interactions
note: Needs interactions in the seed; "Today" is only a guess for the day heading, any unread notice works.

steps.see: Sign in to see replies, likes, mentions and new followers.
Nothing yet. When someone replies to you, likes your comment, mentions you or follows you, it appears here.

name: notifications--interactions-error

steps.see: Couldn't load your interactions right now.

note: The inline (not page-wide) error with a Retry button.

name: notifications--mute-sheet
note: {notice_who} = "<actor name> <verb>", e.g. "Bea replied to your comment"; the ⋯ only shows on reply and like notices.

name: notifications--toast
covers: app/notifications.tsx::toast::Couldn't mute — try again when you're online.
app/notifications.tsx::toast::Muted. No more notices from this thread.

steps.see: Muted. No more notices from this thread.

note: Triggered message: "Muted. No more notices from this thread."

name: notifications-hosts--screen
note: Needs a host announcement in the seed for a show the listener follows.

steps.see: Sign in to see announcements from the shows you follow.
No announcements yet. When a show you follow posts one, it appears here.

name: notifications-hosts--load-failed
note: Fault path is a guess at the host-notices route (m19-api hostNotices).

name: notifications-system--screen
note: Needs a system notice in the seed.

steps.see: No messages from SocialNet yet — announcements and account notices will appear here

name: profile--own
note: {me} = the signed-in account's own listener id. Shows Edit profile, stickers card and Recently played instead of Follow / Message / ⋯.

name: profile--host
note: A host profile shows "Host of 《…》" and the Podcasts row.

name: profile--stats-empty

steps.see: Nothing listened yet. Play something — stats count from the first minute.

note: A new account has public stats with zero listening.

name: profile--suspended
note: {suspended_user} = the seeded suspended account's id.

name: profile--load-failed
note: ApiError that is not a network error shows its own message; low confidence on which text the fault gives.

steps.see: Nothing they write, clip or do will show for you. They will not be told.

name: profile--blocked
note: Blocks {user_name} on this phone (reset between runs).

name: profile--block-dialog-from-blocked-page

steps.see: Nothing they write, clip or do will show for you. They will not be told.

note: BlockButton's own confirm: block, unblock, then block again from the blocked profile.

name: profile--cannot-block-owner

steps.see: You can't block the app's owner — write to them instead.

reason: Only the app owner's account (never in the seed) or your own profile (which has no Block row) can trigger it.

name: profile--toast

steps.see: Muted {user_name}. Their comments are hidden for you.

note: Triggered message: "Muted {user_name}. Their comments are hidden for you."

name: follow-button--toast
note: Triggered message: "Something went wrong." (or the server's own message for the failure; low confidence).

name: profile-followers--own-empty

steps.see: Nobody follows you yet. Share a clip — your name travels with it.

note: Own empty list uses the shared EmptyState sentence; someone else's empty list names them (profile-followers--other-empty).

name: profile-followers--other-empty
note: {user_nofollowers} is a seeded account nobody follows.

name: profile-followers--load-failed
note: The inline error with Retry; the same code serves Following.

steps.see: You follow nobody yet. Tap a name on any comment to see their profile.

name: profile-subscriptions--private

steps.see: This listener keeps their subscriptions private.

note: {user_private} has private subscriptions; the sentence uses their name if passed in the link, otherwise "This listener".

name: profile-subscriptions--empty
note: {user_nosubs} has public subscriptions but none.

steps.see: Sign in to edit your profile.
Couldn't load your profile right now.

name: profile-edit--toast
note: Triggered message: "Profile saved"

name: profile-edit--photo-permission
note: The iOS photo-library alert. Simulator-only system alert.

name: profile-edit--photo-picker
note: After allowing, the native picker opens. The alert button text varies with the iOS version ("Allow Full Access" on 18). Low confidence.

name: status--screen
note: {status} is a status posted by someone else (so More offers Report).

steps.see: This status is gone. Statuses are deleted 24 hours after they are posted.

name: status--more-sheet
note: {user_name} is the status author's display name (the viewer says "You" for your own).

name: status--reply-composer
note: Replies and reactions are part of the viewer page; reaction row, text box and hold-to-record mic.

name: status-replies--toast
covers: src/ui/social/StatusReplies.tsx::toast::SocialNet needs the microphone to record. Allow it in the phone’s settings.
src/ui/social/StatusReplies.tsx::toast::That was too short — hold for at least a second.

steps.see: Sent. Only the poster can see your reply.

note: Triggered message: "Sent. Only the poster can see your reply." ({status} must be another listener's).

name: status--toast
note: Triggered message: "We won't suggest {user_name}'s statuses." {status_suggested} must be a suggested status from someone the viewer does not follow.

name: status-reply--delete-dialog
reason: Opens on a long-press of a reply; the step language has no long-press.

steps.see: Sign in to post a status.

name: status-text--toast
covers: app/status/text.tsx::toast::Posted. It is gone after 24 hours.

steps.see: Posted. It is gone after 24 hours.

note: Triggered message: "Posted. It is gone after 24 hours."

name: status-composer-items--toast
covers: src/ui/social/StatusComposerItems.tsx::toast::Allow photo access in the phone’s settings to add a photo.
src/ui/social/StatusComposerItems.tsx::toast::That picture is too big — pick a smaller one.

steps.see: Allow photo access in the phone’s settings to add a photo.

note: Triggered message: "Allow photo access in the phone’s settings to add a photo." by denying the photo alert (button is "Don’t Allow" with a curly apostrophe).

name: status-text--photo-permission
note: The iOS photo-library alert. Simulator-only system alert.

name: status-text--photo-picker
note: After allowing, the native picker opens. Alert button text varies with the iOS version. Low confidence.

name: voice-new--microphone-permission
note: The first request is the iOS microphone alert (then speech recognition). Simulator-only system alerts.

name: voice-new--recording
note: Needs the microphone already allowed for the account.

name: voice-new--microphone-denied

steps.see: SocialNet needs the microphone to record. You can allow it in the phone's settings.

note: The denied state with the "Open settings" button (the hand-off to the Settings app). Denying the alert is a simulator-only system alert.

name: voice-new--toast
note: Triggered message: "Posted. It disappears in 24 hours." Depends on the simulator recording more than a second; low confidence (the clock text "0:02" is a wait).

name: voice-posts--chooser-sheet

steps.tap: Post a status: voice or text

note: The status row sits on the Library tab.

name: voice-posts--delete-dialog
reason: Opens on a long-press of one of your own statuses; the step language has no long-press.
